capabilities: Set and run countdown timers up to 99:59:59
Start, stop, resume, cancel and reset the timer
Set timers via commands using h/m/s notation
Configure timer buttons, time format and notification type
extras: README references screenshots for the timer UI and verbose format; documented behaviors include the 00:00:00 start guard and a choice between Obsidian and OS notifications.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to set and run a timer with a visible countdown and completion notice.
summary: Countdown timer that runs from a ribbon clock or commands, shows remaining time in the status bar, and notifies when time is up.
